mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'MM/DD') AS sale_date, nvl(sum(total_price),0) as total FROM orders WHERE order_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'MM/DD') ORDER BY MIN(order_date)

select o.order_no, o.id, g.goods_name, d.quantity, to_char(o.order_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday, d.status from orders o, order_detail d, goods g where o.order_no = d.order_no and d.goods_no = g.goods_no and rownum <= 5 order by o.order_date desc, o.id
SELECT qna_no, parent_no, type, subject, content, status, id, to_char(CREATED_AT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday, goods_no FROM qna WHERE status = '답변대기' and rownum <= 5 order by qna_no desc
select count(*) from orders where to_char(order_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(sysdate,'yyyy-mm-dd')
select sum(total_price) from orders where to_char(order_date,'yyyy-mm') = to_char(sysdate,'yyyy-mm')
select count(*) from stock where quantity < 10
select count(*) from order_detail where status = '결제완료'
SELECT 0 as category_no, 'ALL' as category_name FROM dual UNION SELECT category_no, category_name FROM category
SELECT 0 as brand_no, 'ALL' as brand_name FROM dual UNION SELECT brand_no, brand_name FROM brand

SELECT goods_no, goods_discount, goods_code, goods_name, goods_price, poster_url, subposter_url, to_char(g.created_at,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday, g.brand_no, g.category_no, b.brand_name, c.category_name FROM goods g, brand b, category c WHERE g.brand_no = b.brand_no AND g.category_no = c.category_no AND g.goods_no = #{no}
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET goods_code = #{goods_code}, category_no = #{category_no}, brand_no = #{brand_no}, goods_name = #{goods_name}, goods_price = #{goods_price}, goods_discount = #{goods_discount}, poster_url = #{poster_url}, subposter_url = #{subposter_url} WHERE goods_no = #{goods_no}
mapper.insert:
SELECT goods_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO goods (goods_no, category_no, brand_no, goods_code, goods_name, goods_price, goods_discount, poster_url, subposter_url) VALUES (#{goods_no}, #{category_no}, #{brand_no}, #{goods_code}, #{goods_name}, #{goods_price}, #{goods_discount}, #{poster_url}, #{subposter_url})
INSERT INTO stock (no, goods_no, goods_size, quantity) VALUES (stock_no_seq.nextval, #{goods_no}, #{goods_size}, #{quantity})

INSERT INTO stock_history (stock_no, order_no, quantity, inout_size, chk, inout_date, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{stock_no}, #{order_no}, #{quantity}, #{inout_size}, #{chk}, sysdate, sysdate, #{created_by})
mapper.select:
SELECT h.no, h.chk, g.goods_name, h.inout_size, h.quantity, TO_CHAR(h.inout_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dbday, h.created_by FROM stock_history h, stock s, goods g WHERE h.stock_no = s.no AND s.goods_no = g.goods_no
AND h.chk = #{chk}
AND g.goods_name LIKE '%' || #{goodsName} || '%'
ORDER BY h.inout_date DESC, h.no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT g.goods_no, g.goods_name, g.goods_code, b.brand_name, c.category_name, SUM(NVL(rs.quantity, 0)) AS total_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.quantity < 10 THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN '확인필요' ELSE '정상' END AS stock_status FROM goods g JOIN ( SELECT no, goods_no, goods_size, quantity FROM stock ) rs ON g.goods_no = rs.goods_no JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no = b.brand_no JOIN category c ON g.category_no = c.category_no WHERE 1=1
and g.goods_name like '%'||#{goodsName}||'%'
and g.goods_code like '%'||#{goodsCode}||'%'
and rs.quantity < 10
GROUP BY g.goods_no, g.goods_name, g.goods_code, b.brand_name, c.category_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(distinct(g.goods_no))/10.0) FROM goods g JOIN stock rs ON g.goods_no = rs.goods_no JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no = b.brand_no JOIN category c ON g.category_no = c.category_no WHERE 1=1
and g.goods_name like '%'||#{goodsName}||'%'
and g.goods_code like '%'||#{goodsCode}||'%'
and rs.quantity < 10

SELECT g.goods_code, g.goods_no, g.goods_name, b.brand_name, c.category_name FROM goods g, brand b, category c WHERE g.brand_no = b.brand_no AND g.category_no = c.category_no AND g.goods_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' ORDER BY GOODS_NO
SELECT goods_size, quantity, no FROM stock WHERE goods_no = #{goods_no} ORDER BY goods_size ASC
